disclaimer: The weather variables and WMO codes follow the provider contract, but every SAFE/CAUTION/UNSAFE threshold below is an internal project policy—not an aviation authority or manufacturer limit.

sourceReferences.name: DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise specifications
sourceReferences.usedFor: Reference aircraft wind-resistance envelope only (12 m/s published value).

sourceReferences.name: Open-Meteo forecast API documentation
sourceReferences.usedFor: Weather field names, units, heights and WMO weather-code meanings.

DEMO.behavior: Use the selected drone demo profile and show a persistent simulated-weather banner.

LIVE.behavior: Prepared integration contract; not selectable in the current project release.

windSpeed10mMps.basis: Keeps the demo decision margin below the reference aircraft published 12 m/s wind-resistance value.

windGust10mMps.basis: Conservative project rule for gusts; not a manufacturer-certified operating limit.

precipitationMmPerHour.basis: Presentation rule that distinguishes dry, light precipitation, and blocked launch.

visibilityM.basis: Presentation rule for route visibility; not a legal VLOS determination.

wmoWeatherCodesUnsafe.basis: Uses provider WMO meanings; unsafe classification is decided by this project.

runtimeRule: The current project release only allows DEMO mode and generates fresh SIMULATED_FIXTURE snapshots from assigned profiles. LIVE/Open-Meteo remains configured but cannot be selected while marked COMING_SOON.
